article.story:
Portugal started life after Cristiano Ronaldo with a 4-1 defeat to Denmark in Braga, which saw them miss the chance to secure top spot in Nations League Group A4.

Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg had put the Danes ahead with a penalty just before half-time.

Portugal -- who saw Ronaldo call time on his international career last week after a record 234 appearances and 146 goals -- fell further behind as Napoli forward Rasmus Hojlund struck twice in the space of eight minutes after the break.

Club Brugge forward Carlos Forbs had been handed Ronaldo's number seven shirt but could not make an impact when coming off the bench just after the hour.

Joachim Andersen headed in Denmark's fourth goal with 15 minutes left before Bernardo Silva's consolation in added time.
